title: Automatic Garment Folding Machine
description:
Project Overview



Development of an automatic garment folding machine to automate the folding stage in the garment finishing process.



Previous Process



After quality inspection (QC) and ironing, garments were manually folded by operators before being placed into cartons.



Automation Solution



Developed an automatic garment folding machine to replace the manual folding operation with an automated folding process.



The machine was designed to support the garment finishing workflow and reduce repetitive manual folding activities.



My Contribution



Involved in machine development, automation engineering, and implementation of the automatic folding solution.



Implementation



1 unit was developed and implemented.
technologies: Machine Development, Industrial Automation, Garment Handling, Electrical Control, Mechanical Integration
